name: DC8C3
notes: Probed 2026-11-23: values are 0-1 positions, read through a table measured with tools/build-table.mjs.

Threshold, ratio, the main Attack and Release, mix and in/out gain carry. The per-mode attack/release knobs (SMOOTH, PUNCH...), saturation, shape, sidechain filters and Easy-mode settings come back as you left them. Check that Attack/Release are the ones that act in the mode you use.
No in/out: DC8C3 has two parameters both called Bypass.
